lead.headline: Three Big Leaders Gather in a Chinese Tech City
lead.deck: China’s Xi Jinping met Donald Trump at the airport in Shenzhen, and Russia’s Vladimir Putin is there too.
body: On Wednesday, US President Donald Trump landed in Shenzhen, a tech city in southern China, right next to Hong Kong. He came for APEC, a meeting where 21 economies around the Pacific talk about trade.
China’s leader, Xi Jinping, greeted Trump right on the airport tarmac. Xi said he was returning a favour: Trump met Xi at the airport when Xi visited America in September.

Russia’s leader, Vladimir Putin, had arrived earlier. That evening all three went to a welcome dinner, and on Thursday they plan to meet together for the first time ever. They are expected to talk about the wars in Ukraine and Iran, and trade.

map.title: WHERE THE LEADERS MET
map.caption: The map marks China, where the APEC meeting is being held in Shenzhen.

lead.why: The US, China and Russia are three of the most powerful countries in the world, so what their leaders agree, or don’t, can matter everywhere.

world.headline: Europe Plans a Big New Loan for Ukraine
world.deck: The European Union wants to lend Ukraine €45 billion next year.
body: The European Union, or EU, is a group of 27 countries. On Wednesday Ursula von der Leyen, who runs its main office, proposed lending Ukraine €45 billion in 2027, money the EU would borrow together.
Russia’s attacks have hurt Ukraine’s businesses and caused blackouts, so its 2027 budget is short by €70 billion. The loan would cover two-thirds of that gap.
Not everyone agrees: Slovakia, the Czech Republic, Hungary and Bulgaria say they will not take part.
